name: S P Apparels Ltd
tagline: Tirupur-based infant/children's knitwear exporter riding the China+1 apparel-sourcing shift, but a full ~24.5x P/E against modest 11.2% ROE leaves little margin of safety.
business_overview: S P Apparels Ltd (NSE: SPAL) is an end-to-end manufacturer and exporter of knitted garments headquartered near Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, specialising in infant and children's wear (long-standing UK/US retail relationships such as Mothercare) and recently expanding into adult apparel. Seeded via untrusted-X triage (@rajuidesai, 2026-09-13, no thesis detail given).
fundamentals_narrative: The China+1/Bangladesh-diversification tailwind for Indian apparel exporters is real and SPAL is a genuine beneficiary given its established Western retail relationships, and working-capital discipline has visibly improved. But at ~24.5x trailing P/E against an ROE of only ~11.2% and 2.7x book, valuation has already priced in a good chunk of the sourcing-shift story - garment manufacturing itself remains a lower-moat, margin-thin business relative to the multiple being paid.
